Unchanged historical hold/IDs/consumption and exactly one original Paid INV-0002 job. No unrelated unresolved owner or worker transactions.

Verify current restricted execute_payment key, finite allowance, gas balance and exact agent before unpause. Per-payment cap remains 0.001 NEAR; cumulative limit becomes exactly 0.002 NEAR.

Create the new bill only through normal owner/contractor review. Its automatic reference must equal the exact invoiceId in this plan. Any sequence drift requires an amended plan/hash; never edit the reference or counter.
stopConditions: Any changed account, key, nonce, code, method, argument bytes, deposit, gas, funding/fee allowance, checkpoint or review expiry.
Any conflicting hash except cryptographically verified bounded reference-block-only refresh.

Missing evidence, provider disagreement, unknown transaction, wallet rejection, contract failure, stale checkpoint or unsupported receipt shape: preserve attempt and stop; no replacement/signature retry.
No additional bill, order, transfer, worker key change, top-up, deployment, mainnet or ongoing execution.
cleanup: After payment or a conclusively diagnosed failure, pause and revoke using these exact cleanup steps, subject to known owner nonce/outcomes. Unknown owner submissions must be reconciled first; never replace them.
Disable both runtime gates and stop worker. Preserve all attempts and reservations; no unknown transfer may be relabeled Paid.
Verify FINAL transfer to Babygoat for 0.001 NEAR, recipient balance evidence, accounting, matching screens/transaction URL. Requeue/restart same job must produce no additional signature or transfer.
